finalText:
Migrated the 12 remaining files (36 call sites):

- `packages/accounts`: `repo/session.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`, `service/teamService.js`
- `packages/billing`: `repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js`
- `packages/catalog`: `repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js`
- `packages/orders`: `repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js`
- `packages/support`: `repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js`
- `packages/analytics`: `repo/cohort.js`

Two things left deliberately:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9,13`** still calls `db.query`. Its header says it's a vendored copy replaced wholesale on upgrade and local edits are silently lost, so I didn't touch it. You'll need to either patch upstream, wrap it, or keep `db.query` as a shim until the vendor drops it.
- **`cache.query(...)`** calls across many repo files are a different API (cache key, not SQL) — not part of this migration.
